summary: Compares standalone role layout with collection layout, explains roles are referenced by FQCN like mynamespace.mycollection.role1, plugins move out of roles, and plugin directory names are singular in collections.
questions: How does a collection's directory layout differ from a standalone role?
How do I refer to a role inside a collection?
Are plugin directory names plural in collections?

answer_card.title: Standalone roles vs collection roles
answer_card.answer_md: Standalone roles have `library/`, `module_utils/` and `*_plugins/` inside them. In a collection, roles live under `roles/` and plugins move to the collection's `plugins/<type>/` (singular names). Reference roles by FQCN, e.g. `mynamespace.mycollection.role1`.
